mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, order_type, effect_id, tier, amount, status, pay_type, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_order (order_no, user_id, order_type, effect_id, tier, amount, status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{orderType}, #{effectId}, #{tier}, #{amount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM biz_order WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM biz_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_order SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT o.*, u.email AS user_email FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=o.user_id WHERE o.is_deleted=0 AND (u.email LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY o.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE is_deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE is_deleted=0 AND status=1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM biz_order WHERE is_deleted=0 AND status=1
